assumptions.statement: The repository provisional site and key-area polygons are used only for package generation, topology, visualization and proxy metrics.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived values, figures and PDFs must be regenerated when official polygons become available.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, current buildings, ownership, heritage limits, road redlines, utilities, fire access and engineering capacity are not available in cleared form.
assumptions.impact: No parcel-level demolition, development intensity, height, road alignment, utility or construction conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: Waiting bays, robot-free periods, handoff points and test zones are an urban-design operating reference, not an issued permit or approved traffic rule.
assumptions.impact: Field observation, accessibility co-design, operator responsibility, safety assessment and authority approval are prerequisites for any pilot.

assumptions.statement: International and domestic cases are used to compare mechanisms, not to claim direct legal or spatial transferability to Haidian.
assumptions.impact: Local laws, site conditions and accountable professional judgment prevail.
